name: FooterColumn
description: Footer column: a group title and a vertical list of links (Link) leading to related sections. It is grouped with other columns in a footer row.

dos: Short title that groups the links: "Product", "Company", "Help". Do not use a sentence.
Put only Link inside the column, one per destination. Each link carries text saying where it leads.
Use `size="2"` on the Link, as in Figma, so the column has the same text rhythm across the whole footer.
Group columns with few links (3 to 6). If a group has more, split it into two columns with their own title.

donts.case: Buttons or actions inside the column (subscribe, change language)
donts.useInstead: Button or IconButton outside the column, in its own footer block
donts.why: The column is a navigation list. A button inside changes the meaning of the group and the tab order.

donts.case: A long block of text or a paragraph
donts.useInstead: Regular footer text, outside the columns
donts.why: FooterColumn only accepts a title and links. A paragraph has no place and reads poorly in a narrow column.

donts.useInstead: Group of IconButton with aria-label in its own block
donts.why: An icon without text has no accessible name as a Link does. Figma defines no social icons in this column (see needsReview).

donts.case: A column of main application navigation
donts.why: The footer repeats secondary destinations. Main navigation goes in the top bar.

related.difference: Each link in the column is a size 2 Link.
Navbar is the main navigation at the start of the page; FooterColumn groups secondary links at the end.
Bar element with a background; in the footer, Link is used, inline and without background.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the link group. Default text in Figma: "Producto". It is the column's only own text; the links are the links slot.

root.description: Root element. Column with the title and the list of links. Has no background or border.

title.description: Group title. Text of the title prop. Proposal: h2, because the level depends on the page; see needsReview.

links.description: Vertical list of links. 8 px gap between them. Contains Link (size 2 in Figma, three example links).

height.note: Height of the Figma example with three links: 20 px title + 12 px gap + 76 px list (3 × 20 px + 2 × 8 px). Depends on the number of links.

modes.hug: Fits the longest link or title. Figma measures 65 px with "Producto" and "Enlace".

width.note: In Figma the width is HUG. The footer width is decided by the container that groups the columns.

autoLayout.gap: spacing.3 (12 px) between the title and the list of links.

a11y.role: No role of its own (generic container). The title is a heading (h2).
a11y.name: The title (title) names the group. If the column is a section with aria-labelledby, the name is the title.
keyboard: Tab — moves through the column's links in order
a11y.focusIndicator: Inherited from Link (the link's focus ring). FooterColumn adds no ring of its own.
a11y.minTarget: Each Link is 20 px tall in Figma (size 2). Below 24 px: needs an enlarged clickable area or enough space between links (WCAG 2.5.8). See needsReview.
a11y.contrastNote: Title with neutral.12 on the footer background. Links with Link's color. Not measured in Figma.

label.voice: Short group title: "Product", "Company", "Help". The links say where they lead.

behavior.overflow: wrap: the title and links wrap if their text is long. Figma does not define this case.

i18n.rtl: The column aligns left (MIN) in LTR; in RTL it moves to the right. The column order in the footer is decided by the container.
i18n.textExpansion: The HUG width grows with the longest text. With a title or link 30-40 % longer, the column can take more space than the others in the footer.

cases: renders a div with an h2 (title) and a list of Link
title shows the given text; without a value, shows "Producto"
links are 8 px apart and the title sits 12 px above them
the links slot accepts Link and rejects Button, IconButton and NavbarItem
the column has no background or border
the width fits the longest text (HUG)

needsReview: Figma is a COMPONENT (not a set): a single variant and a single state. Name in Figma "Footer/.FooterColumn" (Footer folder and dot prefix, same as .NavbarItem and .FormField). The contract name is FooterColumn.

showSocial property (BOOLEAN, default true): not referenced by any layer of the component. It has no visual effect in Figma, so it has not been added as a prop. Question: remove it from Figma, or is a social icons layer missing that it should show?
title property (TEXT, default "Producto"): the only real prop. Bound to title#41:0.

The three links are fixed Link instances (size 2, regular, no underline, highContrast false) with the text "Enlace" as an instance override. There is no property for the number or text of links. That is why links is a slot with figmaProp null; the minimum of 1 and the unlimited maximum are proposed decisions.

Link size: Figma uses Link size 2, but the Link contract has default value 3. size 2 is recommended in guidance, not forced in the contract (there is no way to fix it without extra props). Confirm whether the column should impose the size.

Touch target: each Link is 20 px tall with 8 px between links. Figma defines no enlarged area. Per WCAG 2.5.8 a minimum of 24 px per target or enough spacing is needed; with 20 px and 8 px the list does not comply. Decide: enlarge the Link's clickable area in the column, or increase the gap.
HTML elements: root div and links div per Figma. Proposals: title h2 and, if list semantics are wanted, links as ul with li (requires Link to be wrapped in li; not in Figma).
Width: HUG, no variable. 12 px and 8 px gaps bound to spacing.3 and spacing.2 in Figma. Height 108 px: derived from the parts, no token.
Title style: text-style.2.bold (14 px, 20 px line height) with neutral.12, bound to a variable. Link style: text-style.2.regular, defined by Link.
Background and border: the root has no fill or stroke in Figma. The column is transparent.

Content, guidance, a11y (h2 as title, no landmark), testing and content: written as a draft. They do not come from Figma. Own decisions: h2 title, root div and the use of Link size 2 as a recommendation.
Contrast not measured. Figma defines no focus or hover states for the column's links.
governance: null, same as Button. Component owners still need to be defined.
